Title: Behavioral Imprint-synced Faceplate (Tier 5)
Description: Advanced FIA spytech based on abandoned Militech research. Pairing it with a behavioral imprint allows the user to take on the appearance of another person as well as replicate their facial expressions and speech pattern. An experienced agent equipped with a faceplate is virtually indistinguishable from the person they're mimicking, and are capable of clearing even the most sophisticated security scans.
